cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Anything but That Question
cards.instruction: Redirect every attempt to discuss the one detail that could expose your real motive or involvement.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. I'll return your spare key after dinner. Have you booked somewhere?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I never gave you a spare key. Where did you get it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Let's get a table before everywhere fills up.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've booked. Did my sister give you that key?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: For two or three? We can't leave your sister without dinner.

mechanism: A treats the key-origin question as a scheduling error and keeps redirecting it into supervised dinner arrangements.
confusable: Random topic changes fail response logic; the evasion must use the exact words B contributes while preserving the avoided key source.
comparison: Reservation management differs from image-editing supervision in the photo alternative.
seedUse: Use spare key and sister question; make the avoidance an overmanaged meeting sequence rather than a professional slogan.
